nodes.label: GLUE Home: Tauri tray app and library engine
nodes.rationale: GLUE Home (Tauri 2, Windows and macOS) is the computer's library engine: performs native analysis in Rust, syncs collections, follows DJ libraries, streams songs to other devices over WebRTC, and serves as the browser's screen when running.

nodes.label: GLUE folder: JSON files as the store
nodes.rationale: User's data in JSON files (no database): profiles, collections, tracks, analysis, lists, sources, backups. Names use lowercase 'mco' (from GLUE's old name) for data compatibility.

nodes.label: GLUE Cloud: Cloudflare Workers and Durable Object
nodes.rationale: Optional account service holding account collections (snapshot and log), profiles, and devices. Never holds music data. Provides signaling for WebRTC and TURN relay credentials.

nodes.label: Song streaming over WebRTC
nodes.rationale: Songs stream from GLUE Home to other devices (phones, other computers) via WebRTC data channels. Service worker answers range requests as streams. Song start timing (connection, first answer, first music, route) logged to console.

nodes.label: Native audio analysis in Rust (crates/glue-audio)
nodes.rationale: GLUE Home performs audio analysis natively using Rust instead of JavaScript, producing summaries (verdict, bandwidth, bit depth, BPM, key), details, fingerprints, spectrograms, and waveforms. Held byte-for-byte to website's results by golden tests.

nodes.label: Collections: Music library organizing songs and playlists
nodes.rationale: A collection holds music folders, DJ libraries, songs, playlists, analyses, and events. Collections can be personal (on one device) or shared across devices via GLUE Cloud.

nodes.label: Profiles: Artist aliases with BPM ranges
nodes.rationale: Artist aliases (id, name, colour, BPM range). Account keeps the list synced across devices; each device picks its own active profile. A GLUE folder has one library that every alias accesses.

nodes.label: Shared collections: Cloud sync across devices
nodes.rationale: When signed in with cloud sync on, every collection is the account's (shared form in GLUE Cloud). Songs are one row with copies on each computer; same file on two computers is one song with a copy on each.
